title: Lesson 1. What a computer is made of
description: Computer parts and how to turn it on and off properly

questions.prompt: What is the computer's screen called?
Match the computer part with the body part
questions.explain: The screen shows, the keyboard listens, the unit thinks, the speakers talk.

questions.prompt: We tell the computer what to do through the keyboard and mouse.

questions.explain: The system unit is the computer's "head".

questions.prompt: You can turn off a computer just by pressing a button like a light.
questions.explain: That way it can lose our work. We turn it off through Start.
Start is at the bottom left.

questions.prompt: What do we do right after turning it on?
questions.explain: The computer wakes up — we wait for the desktop.

questions.text: We turn it off like this: ___ → power icon → "Shut down".
questions.explain: We start with the Start button.

learn.intro: Hi! We're going to make friends with the computer. Today we meet it like a new friend!

slides.text: A computer is like a person. The **monitor** is its eyes: it shows us pictures on the screen.
The **keyboard** and **mouse** are its ears: through them we tell it what to do. The **system unit** is its head, where it thinks. The **speakers** are its mouth: it talks and sings through them.

check.prompt: If I want to type a word, what do I use?
check.explain: The keyboard is the computer's "ears": we tell it letters through it.

slides.text: We turn it on with the power button on the system unit or laptop.
Then we wait for the **desktop** to appear. The computer is waking up — it needs time.

check.prompt: After turning it on, you wait for the desktop to appear.
check.explain: The computer is waking up and needs time.

slides.text: You can't switch a computer off with a button like a light. It may get upset and lose what we made.
We turn it off **politely**: the Start button in the bottom-left corner → the power icon → "Shut down".

check.prompt: Put in order how to turn off the computer
check.explain: First Start, then power, then Shut down.
